subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Forecast Bias
description: A micro-lesson that makes Forecast Bias usable.

hook.text: Sales teams consistently overforecast by 20%. They want more stock to never miss a sale. That's bias.

buildup.text: Forecast bias is the tendency to systematically overpredict or underpredict demand.

discovery.text: Positive bias means forecasts run too high. Negative bias means they run too low. Both waste resources.

twist.text: Bias often comes from politics, not math. Teams inflate forecasts to secure budgets or inventory.

climax.text: Tracking bias over time reveals who consistently inflates or deflates. Transparency fixes the incentive.

punchline.text: Bias hides in every forecast. Measure it to remove it.
